entries.6b45316bedd21b5c: Its strength is the industrial production know-how accumulated since it succeeded in the artificial cultivation of maitake mushrooms. It has "Yukiguni Maitake Kiwami," harvested from a newly developed strain of its own, larger mushrooms of about 900 grams per 1 cluster grown by bag cultivation, culture rooms and fruiting rooms considered the largest in the industry, a growing medium blend that uses no agricultural chemicals or chemical fertilizers, and a direct sales network to retailers.

entries.87e06cd3fc3f831f: Based on the medium-term management plan announced in December 2023, the company is strengthening its research and development functions for medium- to long-term growth. In November 2025, it expanded the Research and Development Office into the Research and Development Division and newly established the Kinoko Research Institute and the Mirai Research Institute. Through research and development centered on mushrooms, it aims to create new technologies and products, working to raise value added and achieve sustainable growth. In parallel, it is optimizing its supply and sales structure in line with market trends and expanding sales opportunities by launching new products.
